company.name: CHAr
company.shortDescription: CHAr is a nonprofit architectural organization that designs housing and urban environments through integrated research and practice.
company.description: CHAr is a nonprofit architectural organization that focuses on housing, architecture, and urban environments through integrated design and research. The organization works on projects ranging from small-scale renovations such as handrails to larger urban planning and housing models. CHAr develops and implements new residential environment models that respond to contemporary social conditions and community needs. It engages in architectural design, consulting, and planning for real estate and neighborhood revitalization projects. CHAr also produces and supervises written and media content related to housing, architecture, and urban development as part of its practice.
